messages:
Priya Nair: quick sync on the authz postmortem follow-ups. i pulled a condensed list of remediation items we agreed on and need explicit owners/etas. want to avoid drift.

Dan Ortiz: thanks priya. paste please so i can update the sprint board.

Priya Nair: pasted minimal list below (R = remediation):
- R1: validate token refresh ordering (race causing stale claims) -> owner: Dan -> ETA: 2026-05-03
- R2: service-account permission matrix + CI gating -> owner: Mei -> ETA: 2026-05-07
- R3: audit-log schema gaps (missing route metadata) -> owner: Liam -> ETA: 2026-04-30
- R4: secrets rotation automation (kms integration + TTL monitor) -> owner: Mei/Dan -> ETA: 2026-05-14
- R5: incident recurrence detection (pattern: token expiry cascade) -> owner: RemediationBot/Liam -> ETA: 2026-05-10

Mei Huang: i'll take R2 and co-own R4. for R2 i'll add a small matrix table and a CI check that fails on unexpected role grants. ETA 5/7 works.

Dan Ortiz: for R1 i'll add an idempotency guard around the refresh endpoint and a short-lived mutex in the cache layer. estimate 3 working days incl tests -> 2026-05-03 confirmed.

Liam Fox: R3 i'll sketch a migration plan: add route_id and deploy_id columns to audit_events, backfill 72h window, then run a small report to validate. query prototype:
```sql
INSERT INTO audit_events_migrated (route_id, deploy_id, actor_id, event_time, payload)
SELECT COALESCE(route_id,'unknown'), deploy_id, actor_id, event_time, payload
FROM audit_events
WHERE event_time >= now() - interval '3 days';
```
Backfill will be staged on the replica to avoid primary load.

RemediationBot: creating tasks: SEC-3001(R1), SEC-3002(R2), SEC-3003(R3), SEC-3004(R4), SEC-3005(R5). Assigning owners.

Priya Nair: governance notes from the postmortem: (a) owners add a short verification blurb to the postmortem doc once done (what changed + how validated + metrics), (b) for cross-team items add a clear handoff in the Jira ticket, (c) set a monthly token-drift quick-check until recurrence detector is live.

Mei Huang: for verification i'll add a tiny test matrix in each PR: unit, integration with staging KMS, and an audit query that proves rotation occurred. i'll post the PR template snippet shortly.

Dan Ortiz: we should also wire an alert on token-validation-failure-rate > 1% for 10m and token-validation-latency 95p > 250ms for 5m. that would have caught the storm earlier.

Liam Fox: agreed. i'll create an observability ticket and a dashboard panel. also plan to emit per-service token-miss counters to metrics-index so the recurrence engine can correlate.

RemediationBot: SEC-3006 created: observability alert wiring. Linking to SEC-3005.

Priya Nair: please paste Jira IDs and final ETAs here once tickets are live so i can update the exec summary. also decide if any item needs escalation to dedicated capacity for testing (e.g., heavy backfill).

Mei Huang: SEC-3002 (R2) ETA 2026-05-07. SEC-3004 (R4) ETA 2026-05-14. added runbook link: https://redwood.example.com/runbooks/secrets-rotation. will note KMS table access in ticket.

Dan Ortiz: SEC-3001 (R1) ETA 2026-05-03. PR will reference runbook change: https://redwood.example.com/runbooks/token-refresh.

Liam Fox: SEC-3003 (R3) ETA 2026-04-30. SEC-3005 (R5) ETA 2026-05-10. dashboards and migration plan attached in ticket.

RemediationBot: weekly remediation channel created -> #incidents-remediate. automated standup scheduled every Wed 09:30 PT. reminders enabled.

Priya Nair: one policy decision: for secrets rotation we agreed to prefer KMS-based rotating keys and short TTLs over application-managed secrets where possible. please reflect that in the runbook.

Mei Huang: noted. i'll update runbook snippet and include a checklist for fallback manual rotation.

Dan Ortiz: for the token canary after deploy, i propose running a post-deploy smoke that exercises 3 critical routes with synthetic tokens and checks permission evaluation for 24h. estimate 1d to add to pipeline.

Liam Fox: i'll supply the synthetic token generator and expected claim sets. also will add a nightly verification job that queries audit events for those token IDs.

Priya Nair: perfect. closing ask: everyone drop a short verification note in the postmortem when done and mark the Jira as VERIFIED with a link to the evidence. i'll pull a status report next Friday.

Mei Huang: will do.

Dan Ortiz: done on my lane.

Liam Fox: adding notes to tickets now.

RemediationBot: SEC-3001/SEC-3002/SEC-3003/SEC-3004/SEC-3005/SEC-3006 created and assigned. follow-up check scheduled in 7 days.
